toolArgumentsForFutureRootApprovedGenera.prompt:
Create a brand-new TRUE RGBA transparent native sprite atlas for the CQC browser fighting game. Do not edit any existing generated atlas. The attached original game references guide silhouette and original palette, not invented fine detail.
Adult RUNNING MAN from ORIGINAL 1990 MSX2 Metal Gear 2. Match original R.MAN captures and tiny sprite: athletic compact human silhouette, green trousers/forearms, pale-grey upper shoulder areas, dark/ochre head and understated ochre/dark boot pixels. UNARMED. Do not use beige generic tactical costume. Exact face/hair/boots are unresolved; minimize invented facial and equipment detail rather than promoting it as official. No firearm, no player mine, no grenade, no sci-fi device. He is a running mercenary; adapted sparring poses are created only for this versus game.
Produce sheet A_LEFT, exactly twelve COMPLETE separate full-body poses, ALL facing anatomically LEFT. Author this orientation independently, never mirror a previous atlas. Every toe, sole, hand and held weapon must remain within its own cell with ample empty transparent margin. Maintain identical character scale and costume across all 12 poses. Native landscape atlas with FOUR columns and THREE rows, read left to right then top to bottom. No text, cell borders, labels, grey matte, checkerboard image background, shadow floor, stage, watermark, detached effects, spare heads or extra mini bodies. Leave clear separation between all 12 connected actor silhouettes. Any held equipment must stay connected to the hands/body. Do not paint projectiles, explosions, flying stars, detached tripwires or muzzle flashes. Full opacity for actual cloth/body/gear; true alpha 0 outside actor. These are native source images and must never be cleaned, scaled or pixel-edited after generation.
Four triplets, numbered 0–11 in this exact order: 0,1,2=idle: calm full-body ready stance, first/second/third small independent motion; 3,4,5=walk: full-body forward walking step, alternate weight then planted step; 6,7,8=guard: adapted unarmed/body guard preparation, held guard then recovery; 9,10,11=crouch: lowering, held full-body crouch, rising.
Render a crisp polished 2D sprite style grounded in the tiny original 1990 silhouette/palette. Do not claim invented anatomical detail, textures, balance actions or hardware is official 1:1. Aim for the nearest supported reconstruction, retain unknown details unobtrusively, and keep every complete pose suitable for independent native source cropping and foot-pivot measurement.
